**InnoS** · validator division of **Inno Solutions JSC**
Registered company, Supermicro-authorized HPC integrator, 1,000+ enterprise server deployments.

🌐 **Track record since 2023: 25 networks**
- Active mainnets: Terra (phoenix-1), Axone, Kiichain, Espresso, Pactus, AR.IO gateway
- Past mainnet: Osmosis, Mantra
- 18 testnets: Celestia, Dymension, Initia, Mantra, Warden, Tanssi, Kiichain, La Tanda, Orbinum, Asentum and more
- Verify on-chain: https://innos.one

🟢 **Gno.land**
- gnoland-1 node synced from genesis on v1.5.0
- Free explorer: https://explorer.innos.one/gnoland
- Years of CometBFT operations make TM2 familiar ground

🛡️ **Operations**
- 24/7 on-call engineers
- Alerts on the first missed block, sync lag and peer loss
- Single signing key, never live on standby nodes
- Encrypted offline key backups, VPN and SSH-key-only access
- Binaries tested before each halt height

💡 **Why gno.land**
Readable, auditable code on-chain and Proof of Contribution match how we work. We aim to earn our seat by contributing, not only signing blocks.

📬 **Contact**
